About.title: What's new
About.subtitle: A short history of the application, so clubs and federation staff can see what changed and which functions were added.
About.release063Title: Import helper dates, issue dates, and card photos
About.release063ImportHelper: Member import uses SimplyCompete Membership End Date as a helper column. It is not stored. You can skip members or import them as Active or Inactive by year.
About.release063IssuedAt: Newly activated licenses now get an issue date, including licenses issued by an LTF admin.
About.release063CardPhoto: If a member has no profile photo, the club logo is used as a faded fallback on the card. Empty photo slots no longer show a dashed box.
About.release062Title: License card preview and capitalized roles
About.release062CardPreview: Club and LTF member Current licenses show the published Standard 3C card above the license table.
About.release062LicenseRoles: Primary and secondary license roles are stored capitalized (Athlete, Coach, and so on). Import still accepts mixed CSV casing.
About.release061Transfers: Club Admins can transfer a member to another club. The other club accepts, with optional fee and club-to-club messages. Active or pending licenses move with the member.
About.release061TransferNotice: The receiving Club Admin gets an in-app notice on login. Review transfers scrolls to Requests and messages.
About.release061WelcomeUsername: The set-password link from the welcome email prefills the username so a password manager can save it with the new password.
About.release060Title: Club admins, club email, and cleaner lists
About.release060ClubAdmins: LTF Admin assigns club admins on a search-first board: pick a club or a member, then connect them. The Admins tab on the club page is gone.
About.release060ClubEmail: Each club can have an email. Invoice mail goes there, or to the club admins if none is set.
About.release060WelcomeEmail: New club admins receive a welcome email with username and a set-password link (Resend in production, Mailpit locally).
About.release060Lists: LTF Members, Licenses, and LTF Finance orders, invoices, and payments use the same flattened list chrome as Club Members.
About.release060CardTemplates: License card templates can be exported and imported. Print PDFs no longer draw bleed or slot guides.
About.release060Payments: After Stripe payment, the success page activates licenses before Go to dashboard. LTF Finance records payments on a full page and other income in an Income register.
About.release050Title: Finance books, import prefix, and shorter LTF IDs
About.release050UiConsistency: The club members look was applied across LTF admin and LTF finance lists, forms, and expandable tables.
About.release050PendingLicenses: Pending licenses are shown as current licenses, with history, member badges, and clearer order-license copy.
About.release050LicenseAvailability: License types can show an availability countdown. Types that are not sold for a year (for example Annual Standard in 2026) are marked unavailable instead of looking orderable.
About.release050FinanceBooks: LTF Finance can record expenses and open year-end books (income statement and balance sheet), with Excel export for annual meetings.
About.release050PrefixRewrite: LTF Admin can rewrite LUX- to LTF- on the LTF license ID during member import, and bulk-update existing LTF IDs. WT IDs stay unchanged. Club admins are told whether the rewrite is on.
About.release050LtfIdDigits: New LTF license IDs use 4 digits (for example LTF-0001) and grow automatically when the number needs more digits.
About.release040Chrome: Visual refresh: sidebar app shell (tab strips removed), KPI overview cards, restyled login and home, and signed-in role navigation.
About.release040Members: Club Members: status pills with live counts, official Kup/Poom/Dan grades (a promotion can be deleted), webcam photo capture, and row click to open the member.
About.release040ClubLists: Club Licenses, Orders, and Invoices use the same toolbar, status pills, page-size options, and pagination as Club Members.
About.release040Iban: Luxembourg IBAN bank lookup uses the official 3-digit bank code, so older Spuerkeess accounts starting with 9 are no longer labelled POST.
About.release040Logos: Club and LTF Settings share a logo manager: drop well, purpose (General, Invoice, Print, Digital), grouped previews, and delete confirm.
About.release040Designer: Full-height designer workspace with Preview & print, Back to designer, and seeded print fonts. Spaces type normally in Text controls. Millimetre print precision is unchanged.
About.release040ClubFilter: LTF and Finance hide the club dropdown on federation-wide pages. Remaining lists filter by club, with All clubs as the default.
About.release040Import: Import confirm uses a yellow notice instead of an alert. The wizard back button says Previous.
About.release039Title: Dashboard shell, members filters, and import review
About.release039Shell: Sticky top bar while scrolling, and Club / LTF / Finance tabs that no longer reorder when switching sections.
About.release039Members: Club Members: live All / Active / Inactive counts, confirmation before toggling a member active, and larger page-size options (50, 150, 300, All).
About.release039Import: Import Step 3 Review: orange status for role issues, inline primary/secondary role fixes, and a confirmation before applying changes.
About.release036Printers: Club and LTF admins can manage their own printer profiles. X/Y offsets apply only on the final PDF, not on the designer canvas.
About.release036Photos: Member photo uploads are more reliable, including clearer messages for server and file-size failures.
About.release035Title: SVG logos and current grade on cards
About.release035Svg: Uploaded SVG logos appear consistently in designer simulation and generated PDFs.
About.release035Grade: Card templates can use the current_grade merge field in preview and print.
About.release035CardSize: LP798 card geometry stays 85.00 × 55.00 mm with exact sheet placement.
About.release034Placement: LP798 placement and multi-image assets (including SVG) were revalidated end to end.
About.release034Parity: Designer ruler, snap, and simulation/PDF parity remain stable after the recovery fixes.
About.release033Title: LP798 precision and role merge fields
About.release033Geometry: Preview and print keep exact LP798 geometry parity.
About.release033Images: Multi-image designs resolve selected uploaded assets, including SVG, across simulation, PDF, and print.
About.release033Roles: Merge fields include primary_license_role and secondary_license_role, with consistent locked date formatting.
About.release032Publish: Publishing a draft now keeps unsaved in-memory edits before publish.
About.release032Assets: Asset library upload is stable for repeated file-picker use.
About.release032Print: Print pipeline hardened: dual-side selection, enqueue failures, and duplicate execution guards.
About.release031Polish: v2 designer bug fixes: rectangle save, per-corner radius, and asset uploads.
About.release030Title: License card designer v2 and smart printing
About.release030Designer: WYSIWYG designer with rulers, snapping, align/distribute, grouping, z-order, undo/redo, and dual-side (front/back) editing.
About.release030Simulation: Live print simulation so the canvas matches the PDF.
About.release030Printing: Smart printing: partial-sheet slot selection, Sigel LP798, and custom papers.
About.release030ClubPrint: Club Admin Quick Print and print history, with a full print audit trail.
About.release020Title: Physical license cards and smart printing
About.release020Designer: Drag-and-drop license card designer for LTF Admin.
About.release020Print: Club Admin quick print and bulk print, including partial-sheet printing (Sigel LP798 and others).
About.release020Preview: Preview with bleed and safe area, plus print history and an audit trail.
About.release015Eligibility: License ordering eligibility is clearer, with fewer flows that end in a dead end.
About.release015Workflows: Payments, orders, member management, and dashboard behaviour received workflow upgrades.
About.release015Dates: Dates display in a consistent format. Member creation and validation are clearer.
About.release014Title: Member editing on the detail page
About.release014MemberEdit: Member editing moved from a modal to the member detail page.
About.release012Finance: Finance workflows and better operational visibility.
About.release011Title: License types, CSV import, and finance
About.release011Types: License type management and expanded admin workflows.
About.release011Finance: First LTF finance and Stripe activation workflows.
About.release010Mvp: Initial LTF License Manager with authentication and role-aware access.
